explanation: It is non-zero only at the GO step of trials late in the episode (about trial 80 onward; it is near 0 before trial 70), when the agent chooses a2 right after a rewarded trial. It hits 10 when that reward comes right after an unrewarded trial, is about 6-8 when the trial before was also rewarded, and is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, after an unrewarded trial, and whenever the agent chooses a1.
